summary: honest neutrino scrutiny, two flags. (1) EXTERNAL: substrate Sum m_nu ~0.10 eV is in ~1.5-2 sigma tension with DESI-2024 LCDM (<0.072) but CONSISTENT with DESI-preferred w0waCDM (<~0.16); minimal NO sum = 0.059 eV. (2) INTERNAL: a geometric cascade r=0.5225 predicts dm21/dm31=0.21 vs observed 0.030 (~7x too large), so the substrate neutrino masses are NOT a simple geometric cascade -- the model needs revisiting. Recorded, not smoothed.
